verified_behaviors: normal 2PC commit reserves both branches exactly once
second-resource prepare failure aborts and restores the first branch
crash before a coordinator decision aborts prepared branches
crash after a durable commit decision commits both branches on recovery
TCC confirm/cancel are state-guarded and idempotent
empty rollback and hanging try cancellation restore stock
limitations: SQLite simulations are not real XA prepared transactions or Seata AT/TCC
No global locks, prepared-transaction blocking or multi-process coordinator failure
Seata Server, Seata dependency and target MySQL 8.4 are not available in this environment
